defectsFoundDuringReview.symptom: in the application the cards had no border, no padding and square buttons
defectsFoundDuringReview.cause: Tailwind drops any layer order statement the application writes, so the message layer was registered first and became the lowest one; the preflight won
defectsFoundDuringReview.fix: the stylesheet is imported into Tailwind's components layer, so it sits above the preflight and below the utilities; the component entry no longer imports it, two owners produced two copies and the first copy decided the layer
defectsFoundDuringReview.guard: tests/e2e/message-presentation.spec.ts measures the card in the application, where the preflight is present; it fails when the import moves back

defectsFoundDuringReview.symptom: closing a message dropped the focus back to the body
defectsFoundDuringReview.cause: the focused close button is removed with the message
defectsFoundDuringReview.fix: the list remembers the region while the button is attached and moves the focus to the next control, or to the programmatically focusable region

defectsFoundDuringReview.symptom: the module was light in the dark application: its border, background and padding were gone
defectsFoundDuringReview.cause: Lightning CSS rewrote light-dark() inside a custom property as var(--lightningcss-light,X)var(--lightningcss-dark,Y); those variables are never defined, so the value was invalid; the dev server does not rewrite it, so the standalone sample looked right
defectsFoundDuringReview.fix: the engine floor is declared in build.cssTarget so the minifier leaves modern css alone, and the module carries no fallback for older engines
defectsFoundDuringReview.guard: the end to end test measures the real background colour of a card in the application, in the dark theme
